> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Identify front speaker wire polarity by side using a wire harness connector. [t1858]

## Tips & gotchas

- Driver Side Positive: 'L' shaped tab (color varies) [t1858]
- Driver Side Negative: Black/White [t1858]
- Passenger Side Positive: Brown [t1858]
- Passenger Side Negative: Black or Red [t1858]
